issue_body: Hey, I use linkding a lot to collect articles that I want to read later. Kind of like Pocket or Wallabag or something like that. Would it be possible to have a setting to make "Mark unread" default to true when adding new links? Or does that exist and did I just miss it?
problem_statement:
Default new links to unread?
Hey, I use linkding a lot to collect articles that I want to read later. Kind of like Pocket or Wallabag or something like that. Would it be possible to have a setting to make "Mark unread" default to true when adding new links? Or does that exist and did I just miss it?
hints_text:
At the moment only with the browser extension, which has a setting for this. I'd be fine with a contribution that adds an option for this to linkding itself.
![1pf-1me](https://github.com/sissbruecker/linkding/assets/1291364/b2f7807a-77c2-493c-b051-ec935f1c2bb6)
